findings.proposedReplacement: In the plane, red shading marks the regions excluded by individual clauses; the feasible LP polygon or segment is green, and the gold point marks the LP optimum. In the cube, red triangles mark the planes cutting off individual corners, rather than shading the full feasible intersection. In the plane, rotate the **objective direction** to see the LP optimum (a vertex of the feasible region, possibly fractional) next to the best *integer* point.
